CustomField.description: Checked = sleeves of this classification are EXCEPTION SLEEVES: they sit outside the model. The Order Ticket wizard takes their dollars off the Expected Account Value first, and the remaining sleeves' target weights are percentages of what is left — so a $50k sleeve beside a $50k exception sleeve on a $100k account is 100%, not 50%. An exception sleeve carries no target weight of its own (its own dollars are what the others are a share of) and is therefore recorded in dollars, which means Allowed Funding Basis is IGNORED for these classifications — this one checkbox is all that is needed to make a classification an exception sleeve. Which classifications count lives here, never in code. See TradeInstructionController.excludedFor / effectiveAllowedBasisFor and c/envelopeFormSchema basisForOption + strategyTotals.allocationBase.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Checked = an exception sleeve: its dollars come off the account value first and the other strategies are weighted against what is left. Always recorded in dollars, whatever Allowed Funding Basis says.
CustomField.label: Excluded From Allocation
